basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old from the Philippines who recently graduated high school. I'm super into gaming, especially tower defense games like BTD6. I spend a lot of my time watching gameplay videos on YouTube, dreaming of playing the games myself. My favorite channels are ISAB and sometimes aliensrock. I can't buy games myself due to lack of payment methods available in my area. When I'm not gaming or watching videos, I'm probably listening to NBAYoungboy or watching comedic shows like Paradise PD. I'm usually online in the evenings, local time. Currently single and looking for part-time work to save up for a gaming setup.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of gaming, particularly tower defense games, mostly acquired through watching YouTube videos and reading discussions online. I'm also interested in whiskey and video editing, as seen from my recent subreddit visits, but I'm just starting out in those areas.
